integrity.claim_scope: Exact sign thresholds and nested connected negative-opinion regions for one weighted hostile bridge with unanimous positive innate opinions.

integrity.review_limit: All assessments are self-review; no independent audit or publication-priority certification.

scientific_limitations: Two internally cooperative connected undirected communities connected by precisely one antagonistic bridge; arbitrary additional negative ties are excluded.
